Use case: ui-mockup. Production-quality UI art direction for existing PC 2.5D platform game LEAF & LEAP. Korean interface. Established warm stylized low-poly fantasy environments and cel-shaded SD Unity-chan heroine (long blonde hair, orange angular hair ribbons, cyan jacket, black clothing). Quiet sophisticated adventure game UI, strong information hierarchy and readable sans-serif Korean typography. Same reusable components everywhere: nearly opaque deep pine panels #132C29, lighter pine #203C36, warm ivory text #F6F1E5, muted sage secondary text #B9C9BD, muted warm gold #D9B76B ONLY for principal CTA/selected state/emblem, dark pine text on gold button. Subtle 8px corners with tiny clipped corners, single thin muted border, generous spacing. No elaborate ornamental line clutter, no excessive glow, no brown muddy panels, no tiny gold text. Clearly distinguish primary/secondary/disabled by fill, icon and label. Text crisp, clean Korean. These are proposed design mockups, not actual captured gameplay. No Unity editor chrome, no browser, no phone/device mockup. Keep 5-world identity: meadow, desert, snowy mountain, coral coast, lava fortress. Data shown are illustrative.
Create ONE landscape 3:2 presentation board showing FOUR equally sized 16:9 game-screen mockups in a precise 2x2 grid with clean gutters and a slim header/footer. Header text "LEAF & LEAP" and "UI 개선 시안". Small panel captions outside screens "01 타이틀", "02 월드맵", "03 플레이", "04 클리어". Maximize screen sizes, do not fill board with explanatory paragraphs.
TOP LEFT title: large elegant existing-style LEAF & LEAP leaf-accent wordmark at left. Calm dark gradient behind LEFT menu only; beautiful sunlit meadow and standing SD blonde heroine on RIGHT. 4 menu rows: gold filled "이어하기", dark secondary "새로 시작", quiet "설정", quiet "게임 종료". Gold is restrained.
TOP RIGHT world map: colorful isometric five-biome island terrain, a readable dotted path with numbered nodes, selected meadow node "1-3" with gold ring. On right compact dark card occupying about 28 percent width, aligned rows: "초원", "1-3", "최고 기록" "01:24.68", "수집품" with two filled leaf-shaped gems and one outline gem and "2 / 3"; one gold CTA "입장". Upper left small "월드맵", upper right single menu icon. No redundant stats or store currencies.
BOTTOM LEFT gameplay: actual SIDE VIEW platformer composition, horizontal grass-topped sandstone ledges, clearly readable small heroine, windmill and distant rolling hills. Top HUD separated into three compact opaque pine plates: left life icon "× 3" and coin icon "128"; center "1-3 초원" and collectible diamonds TWO filled ONE hollow; right clock "00:42.36" and one pause button. No full-width tall panel, center play space unobstructed. Do not render combat health bar as lives.
BOTTOM RIGHT clear result: darkened meadow background, centered pine results card, small GOLD TRIANGLE emblem now lifted above heading "스테이지 클리어". Below triangle a very large "01:24.68" labeled "클리어 기록", compact "최고 기록 갱신" badge, one collectible row "수집품  2 / 3". Bottom gold primary "다음 스테이지"; smaller secondary "다시 도전" and "월드맵". Hierarchy time first, secondary info next. Do not add stars/rank/score rewards unsupported by project. Small footer outside panels "공통 패널 · 명확한 숫자 · 하나의 핵심 버튼".

Create a SINGLE full-size landscape 16:9 in-game HUD redesign mockup matching the supplied overview's BOTTOM LEFT screen, refined for readability. Full-bleed game image, no external frame, no design-board captions. Bright stylized SIDE VIEW 2.5D meadow platformer, staggered grass-topped rock platforms, some coins, windmill left background, distant mountains, charming small blonde SD Unity-chan running near lower center-left. Show enough open play space to judge HUD obstruction. Game environment should look like clean cel-shaded low-poly 3D, not realistic.
At top with generous consistent 32px-equivalent safe margins, THREE separated same-height dark pine opaque plates, ivory text:
LEFT plate: round small character face icon followed by "× 3", vertical separator, coin icon followed by "128". This is life count, NOT HP. Do not add health bars, quests, minimaps or combat skills.
CENTER plate: small chapter label "1-3 초원"; vertical separator; exactly three leaf collectible slots TWO filled gold ONE outline, compact "2 / 3". All use same icon family as supplied overview. Stage and collectibles balanced, no oversized heading.
RIGHT plate: clock icon followed by a very legible tabular "00:42.36"; a separate square pause button aligned alongside it. White timer numerals on dark pine, no glow. Time not duplicated elsewhere.
Every HUD plate subtle small corner cuts, only one quiet thin border, no baroque gold flourishes. No interface at screen bottom. Plenty of empty space between plates and gameplay. Create a SINGLE full-size landscape 16:9 SETTINGS screen redesign mockup, faithful to the supplied overview's UI components. Softly dimmed blurred meadow and windmill background, centered wide opaque pine settings panel about75% viewport width with safe exterior margins. It must be a readable practical game settings screen, NOT fantasy parchment or dense dashboard.
Header left "설정", header right a clear close X in square outline button. Interior one broad content area with aligned label, control and value columns; group Language, Audio, Display with fine section separators and generous whitespace. No side navigation or tabs needed for these six settings.
Top content row label "언어", single wide dropdown "한국어" with down chevron, replacing five visually equivalent language buttons.
Then fine separator and small section heading "사운드".
Three aligned rows: "전체 볼륨" with slider at80% and numeric "80%"; "배경음" slider at60% and "60%"; "효과음" slider at90% and "90%".
Track backgrounds muted sage, filled portion warm gold, clear ivory circular handle. Slider fill length accurately corresponding to each number. Values in fixed right aligned column.
Fine separator and small section heading "화면".
Two aligned rows: "전체 화면" right aligned ON toggle and visible label "켜짐"; "수직 동기화" right aligned OFF toggle and visible label "꺼짐". Toggle label plus position conveys state, not color alone. Clearly different ON/OFF fill.
Footer thin separator. Left small muted text "변경 사항은 자동으로 저장됩니다". Right ONE prominent gold button "완료" with dark text, keyboard hint "Esc 닫기" separate small ivory text nearby.

Do not invent resolution dropdown, graphics presets, store currencies or accounts.
High legibility, no oversized blank areas, no decorative gold frames around every label. Uniform typography and icon weight.
